description.zh: 模型部署使用的AINode节点列表。
description.en: The list of AI nodes used for model deployment.

description.zh: 幂等性校验。更多信息，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~327176~~)。
description.en: The idempotency check. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~327176~~).

description.zh:
实例ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~)接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的实例ID。
description.en:
The instance ID.

> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a region.
Specifies whether to enable public network access.
The inference engine. Currently, only vllm is supported.
The model parameters. This parameter is not supported.
The number of model service replicas.

description.zh: 实例当前所属的资源组ID。如何获取资源组ID，请参见[查看资源组基本信息](~~151181~~)。
description.en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs. For information about how to obtain the resource group ID, see [View basic information of a resource group](~~151181~~).

description.zh:
IP白名单。

127.0.0.1表示禁止任何外部IP访问，您可以在实例创建完成后调用[ModifySecurityIps](~~86928~~)接口修改IP白名单。
description.en:
The IP whitelist.

The value 127.0.0.1 indicates that no external IP addresses are allowed to access the instance. After the instance is created, you can call the [ModifySecurityIps](~~86928~~) operation to modify the IP whitelist.

descriptions.zh: 请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版产品的[收费方式](~~35406~~)和<props="china">[价格](https://www.aliyun.com/price/product#/gpdb/detail/GreenplumPost)</props><props="intl">[价格](https://www.alibabacloud.com/zh/product/hybriddb-postgresql/pricing)</props>。
descriptions.en: Before you call this operation, make sure that you are familiar with the [billing methods](~~35406~~) and <props="china">[pricing](https://www.aliyun.com/price/product#/gpdb/detail/GreenplumPost)</props><props="intl">[pricing](https://www.alibabacloud.com/zh/product/hybriddb-postgresql/pricing)</props> of AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb create-model-service --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --model-name Qwen3-Embedding-8B --description test --security-ip-list 127.0.0.1 --ai-nodes ai-xxxxxx --model-params Not_yet_available. --resource-group-id rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --client-token 0c593ea1-3bea-11e9-b96b-880000000000 --replicas 1 --inference-engine vllm --enable-public-connection false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb CreateModelService --region cn-hangzhou --ModelName 'Qwen3-Embedding-8B' --Description test --InferenceEngine vllm --ResourceGroupId 'rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000' --DBInstanceId 'gp-xxxxxxxxx' --SecurityIPList '127.0.0.1' --EnablePublicConnection false --AiNodes '["ai-xxxxxx"]' --ModelParams 'Not_yet_available.' --ClientToken '0c593ea1-3bea-11e9-b96b-880000000000' --Replicas 1
